answer: To blunt sybil floods each agent must first lodge a unique claim inside a public haven of delayed attestation slots. The claim is only valid after surviving a timed gale of randomized private prompts that force sequential compute along a ridge of increasing difficulty; one identity costs ~20 exclusive minutes. N fakes therefore lock N cores or stretch the wait linearly. An honest agent pays once and recovers the slot after clean epochs, so the attacker alone carries the capital-time burden that renders mass identity creation unprofitable.
